organization.name: LimeSurvey GmbH
organization.notes: German GmbH operator verified. Project copyright reaches 2003, but copyright alone is not a verified project-start or company-foundation date. Official About/company routes failed and funding/ownership search found no primary transaction announcement; funding and ultimate shareholders remain unresolved.

pricingTiers.name: Community Edition
pricingTiers.notes: Software license cost is zero; infrastructure, extensions and external services can cost extra.
Expert has Best price label, which is not Most popular or Recommended; no qualifying designation verified.

pricingTiers.name: Business
pricingTiers.notes: Current localized page displays JPY10,242/month billed annually ×12. Also displays underlying EUR693 equivalent; local reference exchange rates can change. Cloud scope distinct from CE and paid ComfortUpdate.

pricingTiers.name: Corporate
pricingTiers.notes: Tailored survey solution via sales; no fixed price.

moats.claim: A mature research-oriented question/logic model and reusable survey assets create expertise and migration costs for established research teams.

productReasons.claim: ExpressionScript and question logic enable complex branching, calculations and validation in research questionnaires.
Multilingual surveys and reusable label sets support international research without separate questionnaire systems.
Participant management, quotas and statistical exports support controlled survey sampling and analysis.

sponsorship.notes: Community contribution and donation sources checked without a verified corporate sponsor roster. Verified LimeSurvey GmbH business operator supplied as fallback; commercial partners are not automatically sponsors.

requirements.notes: LS7:8.1.29+ tested through8.4; LS6:8.1–8.3. Match installed major.

requirements.component: PHP-capable web server and PHP extensions
requirements.notes: mbstring, correct PDO driver, cURL and default PHP libraries including session, fileinfo, SimpleXML and crypto.

resources.notes: Disk minimum excludes growing survey uploads and database; CPU/RAM minimum not published in reviewed installation page.

selfHosting.notes: No baseline Redis, separate queue or object store required in official CE installation. Email delivery configuration needed for invitation workflows; exact SMTP route not verified in this pass.

oneClickInstall.notes: Official installation manual documents downloading, uploading and configuring application/database and running browser installer; no currently verified official-link marketplace or one-command install option found.
